script_text: Gemini, your witty mind is about to crash into Taurus's stubborn brick wall. You're an Air sign ruled by Mercury, always darting between conversations, while Taurus is an Earth sign ruled by Venus, craving slow, sensual stability. Your Mercury in Gemini squares their Mars in Taurus, creating communication friction where you want instant replies and they need lengthy contemplation. Your Venus in Gemini trines their Venus in Taurus, generating magnetic attraction through shared values of beauty and harmony. However, your mutable nature conflicts with their fixed determination, especially in the 7th House of partnerships versus their 10th House of career ambitions. This opposition creates tension between your social networking goals and their steady climbing aspirations. Saturn in Pisces aspects both your charts, testing whether this relationship can mature through compromise or dissolve through frustration. The key turning point arrives when you learn to appreciate their slow-burn romance instead of rushing past it. Comment your partner's sign!
